name: Fenix CL26R Pro rechargeable lantern
summary: A rechargeable lantern with area, downward and red lighting modes for shared rooms, work surfaces and a portable blackout lighting kit.
description: Choose a lantern by the light pattern needed in the room as well as its maximum output. This model can hang above a work surface or illuminate a shared area. The maximum combined output and maximum runtime refer to different settings; neither should be presented as an independently measured blackout runtime.

specs.label: Charging
specs.value: USB-C; approximately 3.5 hours with a suitable 5 V / 2 A adapter

specs.label: Maximum advertised runtime
specs.value: Up to 408 hours; mode-dependent, not at maximum output

specs.label: Water resistance
specs.value: IP66 per manufacturer; not an immersion rating

specs.label: Lighting modes
specs.value: Nine: area levels, front light, downward levels, red and red flash

pros: Magnetic mounting and a hanging hook support hands-free placement.
Separate downward and area lighting provide useful placement choices.
cons: Output can step down as the lantern gets hot.
Available modes are restricted while charging or powering another device.
Camouflage colour and included battery must still be matched to the listing.
useCases: Plan rechargeable area lighting for a shared room.
Use directed light for a tabletop task without lighting the entire room.
